content: Einpwoat Mer
Ni rahn kaeisek en kaeisek en sounpwong en sounpar kaduwau en at kalipilipala, KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie,
“Kowe, nein aramas, ntingihedi depehn sounpwong rahnwet, pwehki iei rahnwet me nanmwarkien Papilonia tapihada kapilpene Serusalem.
Padahkihong nei aramas kahngohdi kan karasaras pwoatet me ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, mahsanihong irail:

content.text: Kihdiong loale uduk me keieu kaselel—
uduk en peh kan, oh neh kan—
pil audehkihla tih me kin keieu iou kan.
Doadoahngki uduk en sihpw me keieu kaselel;
pwoailihada tih kan oh uduk kan.”

content: Ih met me KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahmahsanih: “Meid suwediong kahnimw en kamaramaso! E rasehng einpwoat mer ehu me sohte mwahn kin kamwakelda. Kisin sansar en uduk kan kin kohkohsang, oh sohte ehu kin luhwehdi loale.
Kamaramas wiewiawi nan kahnimwo, ahpw nta kan sohte wudekdiong nan pwehl wasa me pwelpar kak karirihala; e wudekdiong pohn paip kalaimwun ehu me mi pohn pwehl.
I mweidohng ntao en mihmi wasao, wasa me sohte pahn rirla, wasa me e pahn sansal ie oh ale dupukpe.”
Ih met me KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahmahsanih: “Meid suwediong kahnimw en kamaramaso! Pein ngehi me pahn saunehng eihn einpwoato.
Kumwail wahdo pil ekei tuwi! Kumwail irip kisinieien! Pwoailihada uduken! Pwoailih suhpwen lao ngalangalada! Isikala tih kan!
Met kihdiong tehn einpwoat prons en pohn mwoalus kan oh mweidohng en weitahtahla. Einpwoat en ahpw pahn pwurehng mwakelekellahng kaudok mwurin mer kan eh pahn kohsang,
mehnda ma mer koaros sohte pahn sohrala nan kisinieio.
Serusalem, omw wiewia suwed kan kasamineiukalahr. Mehndahte ei kin nannantihong en kamwakeleiukada, ahpw ke kin samisaminte. Ke sohte pahn pwurehng mwakelekella lao ke pehm engin ei engieng unsek.

Ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen. E lelehr ahnsoun ei mwekid. I sohte pahn meliehla dipomw kan de poakeiukala de kupwurkalahngan ong uhk. Ke pahn ale kalokepen omw wiewia kan.” KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, me mahmahsen.
Mehlahn en Soukohpo eh Pwoud
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie,
“Kowe, nein aramas, ahnsou tehkis I pahn kihsang aramaso me ke keieu poakohng. Ke sohte pahn kaulim de sengiseng de kakerehdi pilen mesomw.

Kaleke e de mie ngilen omw sengiseng. Kaleke ke sehkasang pitenmoangomw de sohte suht alialuseli pwehn wia kilel en nsensuwed. Kaleke ke perehla mesomw de kang kisin mwenge me sounmwahiei kan kin kang.”
Nimenseng en rahno I koasoiong aramas ako. Nin soutiko ei pwoudo kapilsalehdala, oh mahndahn rahno I ahpw wia dahme kohieng ie I en wia.
Aramas ako eri kalelapak rehi, “Dahme komw wiewiahki soangen mwekid wet?”
Ngehi eri patohwanohng irail, “KAUN-O ketin mahseniong ie

I en patohwanohng kumwail mehn Israel kan mahsen wet: Kumwail kin pohnmwahsohki kehlail en Tehnpas Sarawio. Kumwail kin men pwarek oh kilang, ahpw KAUN-O pahn ketin mweidohng en saminla. Oh kisehn amwail peneinei me pwulopwul kan me luhwehdi nan Serusalem pahn mehla nan mahwen.
Kumwail ahpw pahn wia dahme I wiahiero. Kumwail sohte pahn perehla masamwail kan de tungoale kisin tungoal me sounmwahiei kan kin tungoale.

Kumwail sohte pahn sehkasang pitenmoangamwail de sohte suht alialuseli de mwahiei de sengiseng. Kumwail pahn luhluwetala pwehki dipamwail kan, oh kumwail pahn ingihngitingki amwail medek nanpwungamwail.

I ahpw pahn wiahla kilel ehu ong kumwail; kumwail pahn wia mehkoaros me I wiahier. KAUN-O ketin mahsanih me ahnsou me mepwukat pahn pweida, eri, kumwail pahn esehla me iei ih KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie.”

KAUN-O eri mahsanih, “Kowe, nein aramas, I pahn adihasang irail Tehnpas Sarawi kehlailo me re kin pohnmwahsohki oh perenki, me re kin mwahuki pwarek oh kilang. Oh I pahn pil adihasang neirail pwutak oh serepein kan.
Ni rahn me I pahn kapwaiada met, mehmen me pahn pitsang paisuwedo pahn kohdo oh pakairkihong uhk duwen mepwukat.
Ni rahnohte ke pahn pwurehng lokaiahda, oh ke pahn iang koasoi. Ih duwen met omw pahn wia kilel ehu ong aramas akan, oh re pahn esehla me ngehi, KAUN-O.”
